instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure all interactive elements (buttons, inputs, BHK selectors, room toggles, accordion triggers, tab buttons) contain meaningful kebab-case data-testid attributes.
Use Lenis smooth scroll for momentum scrolling feel.
Form submission for Consultation or Vaastu guide must display an elegant custom Toast (Sonner) with thank-you feedback.
The cost estimator must react immediately to BHK, package tier, and room scope toggles, recalculating price ranges live in INR (₹ Lakhs).
Ensure 390px mobile responsiveness with touch-friendly targets (min 44px height).
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: DO NOT use generic centered layouts or unstyled default components.
Always set explicit hover text states (e.g., hover:bg-primary hover:text-white).
All components must be pure JS/JSX in /src/ components.
